title: D.Rho and ivy6 share new single "Blazin’ Baby BoneCrusher"
htmlContent:
D.Rho, together with ivy6, crafts a one-of-a-kind audio masterpiece titled “Blazin’ Baby BoneCrusher.” The sound has a dark, beautiful, conflicted trap sound that is truly one of a kind and full of vibes. While some artists fear experimentation, fearing it might not appeal to their fan base, D.Rho has always run towards it. 

Core music is a type of music that you can feel. D.Rho and Ivy6 connect to give us a super soulful experience on the new love song “Blazin’ Baby BoneCrusher.” The sound is refreshing and feels good to hear, with each groove feeling like a breeze worth getting swept away in.
